verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own marketing says it uses AI to help users 'declutter & find the most impactful opportunities' in their feedback data, which is in-product AI insight. This is a single thin claim with no documented details on what insights or suggestions are generated, or how. The customer-facing AI answers and the Fibi support agent serve end customers, not the user's own data analysis, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented description of the AI insight/suggestion features (e.g., clustering, prioritization recommendations, summaries), how they surface in the dashboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Featurebase helps you declutter & find the most impactful opportunities with AI.
